sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Release tracklist: the script now also runs on MusicBrainz's single-medium links, /release/<mbid>/disc/<n>, including the form that points at one track (/release/<mbid>/disc/<n>#<track>). MusicBrainz highlights that track in pale yellow; after "Show all Tracks" the consolidated tracklist keeps the highlight, through filtering and sorting too, and scrolls the track into view once. A cell carrying a warning (length mismatch, video on the wrong medium, no work) keeps its own colour.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: 📊 "Title info" sections (see WIP.1) now also appear on other columns that hold a title: by default "Name", "Recording", "Release", "Release group", "Release groups" and "Work" — an artist's recordings, releases and works, a release group's releases, an area's releases, and so on. The list is editable in ⚙️ Settings ("Unique-Values Dropdown: Title Info On These Columns Too"); leave it empty for Title columns only.

Only a cell whose title links a recording, release, release group, work or track counts, on every column including Title, so an artist or label name (e.g. "ABBA") is never read as an ALL-UPPERCASE title.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Release tracklist: a track whose recording is not linked to any work (empty "Recording of work" cell) now has its Title cell tinted like a length over the threshold, with a ⚠️ and a tooltip. The Title column's 📊 "Title info - Work" section (see WIP.1) counts these tracks either way. The marking survives Save to Disk / Load from Disk. Switch it off in ⚙️ Settings → 💿 RELEASE TRACKLIST ("Flag tracks whose recording has no associated work").

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: 📊 dropdown on every Title column: new "Title info" sections following MusicBrainz's title style guide (https://musicbrainz.org/doc/Style/Titles). "Medley" (titles starting with "Medley:", "Medley 2:", …), "Multiple titles" (several titles joined by " / "), "Number of titles", and "Single title" with one entry per title inside them. "Work": whether the track's "Recording of work" column links a work (release tracklists). "Extra title information": a trailing "(…)"/"[…]" in lowercase, such as "(single version)" or "(live)", with one entry per text. Ticking a medley, a title, an ETI text, a series number or a format word marks it in the title.

Four more Title sections, each with its own switch in ⚙️ Settings: "Subtitle" ("Biography: The Greatest Hits"), "Series numbering" (", Volume 1", ", Part 3", ", Pt. II", …), "Format designation" (EP/LP/CD/Single in the title) and "Style issues" (titles cut off with "…", OC ReMix titles, ALL-UPPERCASE titles).
📊 dropdown on every Rating column: "Rating info - Presence" — "🌟 has a rating" and "☆ no rating".
